# GitHub Copilot Instructions for ARES-Health

* Project: ARES-Health (NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026).
* Operational mode: 100% offline edge-native execution. Do not generate code that requires external cloud APIs.
* Invariant: ZERO EMOJIS in code, comments, or documentation.
* Core language for backend: Safe Rust 2024 on Tokio runtime.
* Core language for frontend: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Three.js / React-Three-Fiber.
* Mathematical rigor: All equations must respect physical dimensions (e.g., shear stress in dyn/cm2).
* Refer to `AGENTS.md` for complete architectural rules and guidelines.
